#Read in polygons of breeding 
```{r}
AK <- st_read("AMKE_shapefiles_rasters/genoscape_polygon/AMKE_crop.genoscape_brick_4.45no_ovlp.WGS84.shp") 
West <- st_read("AMKE_shapefiles_rasters/genoscape_polygon/AMKE_crop.genoscape_brick_2.45no_ovlp.WGS84.shp") 
TX <- st_read("AMKE_shapefiles_rasters/genoscape_polygon/AMKE_crop.genoscape_brick_5.45no_ovlp.WGS84.shp") 
East <- st_read("AMKE_shapefiles_rasters/genoscape_polygon/AMKE_crop.genoscape_brick_1.45no_ovlp.WGS84.shp") 
FL <- st_read("AMKE_shapefiles_rasters/genoscape_polygon/AMKE_crop.genoscape_brick_3.45no_ovlp.WGS84.shp")

ggplot() +
  geom_sf(data = East,alpha = 0.75, aes(fill = "blue")) +
  geom_sf(data = West,alpha = 0.75, aes(fill = "yellow")) +
  geom_sf(data = AK,alpha = 0.75, aes(fill = "cyan"))

genoscape <- rbind(AK,

#defining order
```

#Let's look at data
```{r}

  geom_sf(data = ecoregions,alpha = 0.75, aes(fill = Region)) +

```

The genetic data have the probabilty that each individual is assigned to a specific genetic population. These data are used during the resampling process to estimate transition probabilities and the strength of MC. Below, we format the data so we can easily use it in our analysis.

```{r, eval=FALSE}
# Note that we re-order the probabilities to match the order of originNames #
AMKE_genetics <- as.matrix(genetic_samples[,c("AK", "West","East")])
AMKE_genetics_df <- as.data.frame(AMKE_genetics)

```

#Read in banding data
#Sample, AK, West, East, FL, Lat, Long, Stage
```{r, eval=FALSE}
##Unfiltered by number per site
recmatrix<-read.csv("4.Combined MigCon/AMKE814_recovery_matrix_all_data_filt1.csv",row.names = 1)

#Filtered for sites with greater than 2 inds
recmatrix_filt <- read.csv("4.Combined MigCon/AMKE814_recovery_matrix_all_data_filt1.csv",row.names = 1)  %>%
  rename(`Eastern Temperate Forests`=`Eastern.Temperate..Forests`,`Highland/Interior Mexico`= `Highland.Interior.Mexico`,`North American Deserts`= North.American.Deserts, `Southeastern US`= Southeastern.US , `Southcentral US`= Southcentral.US, `Northern Forests`= Northern.Forests,`Great Plains`= `Great.Plains` ) %>% 
  mutate(`Southwest Mexico`= 0, `Northern Andes`=0, `Atlantic Lowland Mexico`=0, `Highland Central America` =0, California =0, `Marine West Coast Forests` = 0, `Northwestern Forested Mountains` =0,`Northwest Mexico` =0) %>%
  mutate(`Eastern Temperate Forests2`=(`Eastern Temperate Forests` + `Northern Forests`)) %>% 
  dplyr::select(-c(`Northern Forests`,`Eastern Temperate Forests`)) %>% 
  rename(`Eastern Temperate Forests`=`Eastern Temperate Forests2`)  %>% 
  dplyr::select(`Atlantic Lowland Mexico`, California,`Eastern Temperate Forests`,`Great Plains`,`Highland Central America`,`Highland/Interior Mexico`,`Marine West Coast Forests`,`North American Deserts`, `Northern Andes`,`Northwest Mexico`,`Northwestern Forested Mountains`,`Southcentral US`,`Southeastern US`, `Southwest Mexico`) 


#Claire reordering
desired_order <- c("AK","West","East")

#keep only West & East from real data
updated_matrix <- recmatrix_filt %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  rownames_to_column("Cluster") %>%
  filter(Cluster %in% desired_order)

#add AK as zeros IF missing
if(!"AK" %in% updated_matrix$Cluster){
  ak_row <- data.frame(Cluster = "AK",
                       matrix(0, nrow = 1, ncol = ncol(recmatrix_filt)))
  colnames(ak_row)[-1] <- colnames(recmatrix_filt)
  updated_matrix <- rbind(updated_matrix, ak_row)
}

#enforce correct order
updated_matrix <- updated_matrix %>%
  arrange(match(Cluster, desired_order)) %>%
  column_to_rownames("Cluster") %>%
  as.matrix()

```

##Target points
# combine all the target locations into a single object 
# NOTE - we reorder the columns to match between the data sets
```{r, eval=FALSE}
targetPointsAMKE <- rbind(targetPoints_genetic[,c("Type","geometry")],targetPoints_bbl[,c("Type","geometry")])

# Transform (re-project the data) into Equidistant conic projection
#targetPointsAMKE<- st_transform(targetPoints_genetic, "ESRI:102010")
```

```{r, eval=FALSE}
# Transform (re-project) data into Equidistant conic projection 
targetSitesAMKE <- st_transform(ecoregions, "ESRI:102010")

#Claire- changed points to same projection
targetPointsAMKE <- st_transform(targetPointsAMKE, st_crs(targetSitesAMKE))

# Create a vector of the target assignments of the input data
targetAssignment <- suppressMessages(unclass(sf::st_intersects(x = targetPointsAMKE,                                                             y = targetSitesAMKE,                                                         sparse = TRUE)))

# Set any target assignment that results in 0 to NA
targetAssignment[lengths(targetAssignment)==0] <- NA

# convert from a list to an array #
targetAssignment <- array(unlist(targetAssignment))

# If the assignment is NA - assign to the nearest targetSite
targetAssignment[is.na(targetAssignment)] <- sf::st_nearest_feature(x = targetPointsAMKE[is.na(targetAssignment),], y = targetSitesAMKE)

```

```{r, eval=FALSE}

#redefining order
updated_matrix <- updated_matrix[c("AK","West","East"), ]
band_matrix <- band_matrix[c("AK","West","East")]
AMKE_genetics <- AMKE_genetics[, c("AK","West","East")]
band_matrix

#run transition
st_crs(targetPointsAMKE) <- st_crs(originSitesAMKE) <- st_crs(ecoregions)
est.psi.gen_band <- estTransition(originSites = originSitesAMKE,
                          targetSites = ecoregions,
                          targetPoints = targetPoints_genetic,
                          originAssignment = AMKE_genetics,
                          isTelemetry = FALSE,
                          isRaster = FALSE,
                          isProb = TRUE,
                          captured = "target",
                          targetNames = target.names,
                          originNames = origin.names,
                          targetRelAbund = target.abund,
                          verbose = 3,
                          nSamples = 100,
                         banded = band_matrix, 
                         reencountered = updated_matrix,
                         dataOverlapSetting="none",
                         method="bootstrap"
                          )

summary(est.psi.gen_band)
```

#Calculate relative abundance, plot weighted alluvial
```{r}
Breeding<-c("AK","West", "East")
#actual abundance
origin.abund <- br_abunds$Relative_abundance[c(1,2,3)] 
#reduce West abundance for plotting purposes, 25% of it's global abundance
origin.abund[c(2)] <- origin.abund[c(2)]*.4
origin.abund <- origin.abund / sum(origin.abund)
d<-as.data.frame(origin.abund)
d2<-cbind(Breeding,d)
d2

amke_conn_df_abun<-amke_conn_df %>%
  mutate_all(.,function(col){d2$origin.abund*col})
amke_conn_df4<-cbind(d2,amke_conn_df_abun) %>% dplyr::select(-origin.abund)

row.sum <-apply(amke_conn_df4[1:3,2:10],1,sum)
col.sum <-apply(amke_conn_df4[1:3,2:10],2,sum)

amke_conn_df_abun <- amke_conn_df4 %>% 
  pivot_longer(cols = MWCF:ETF, names_to = "Nonbreeding", values_to = "Connectivity") %>%
  mutate(Connectivity = ifelse(Connectivity < 0.0001, 0, Connectivity)) %>%
  mutate(Breeding = factor(Breeding, levels = rev(brnode_names)),
         Nonbreeding = factor(Nonbreeding, levels = rev(nbnode_names)))


amke_conn_df_abun <- as.data.table(amke_conn_df_abun)

amke_lodes <- to_lodes_form(as.data.frame(amke_conn_df_abun),
                            axes = 1:2,
                            id = "Con")
amke_lodes <- as.data.table(amke_lodes)
mamke_lodes <- merge(amke_lodes[x == "Breeding",], amke_lodes[x == "Nonbreeding",], by = "Con")
mamke_lodes[,color := stratum.x]
amke_lodes <- merge(amke_lodes, mamke_lodes[,.(Con, color)], by = "Con")

pop_colors <- as.data.frame(matrix(c("Northern Forests", "#CC6677", "NF",
                                     "North American Deserts", "#332288", "NAD",
                                     "Great Plains", "#DDCC77", "GP",
                                     "Southcentral US", "#117733", "SCUS",
                                     "Highland/Interior Mexico", "#88CCEE", "HIM",
                                     "Eastern Temperate Forest", "#882255", "ETF",
                                     "Southeastern US", "#999933", "SEUS",
                                     "Atlantic Lowland Mexico", "#44AA99", "ALM",
                                     "Highland Central America", "#533956", "HCA",
                                     "Southwest Mexico","#d1f0e1","SWM",
                                     "California","#303942","CAL",
                                     "Northwest Mexico","#ce7f60","NWM",
                                     "Northwestern Forested Mountains","#cec106","NWFM",
                                     "Northern Andes","#1e264b","NAndes",
                                     "Marine West Coast Forests","#fbded5","MWCF"
                                    ), byrow = TRUE, ncol = 3))

pop_colors_vec <- pop_colors[,2]
names(pop_colors_vec) <- pop_colors[,3]

g.alluvial <- ggplot(amke_lodes,
       aes(x = x, y = Connectivity, stratum = stratum, fill = color, label = stratum,
           alluvium = Con)) +
  geom_alluvium(width = 1/12, show.legend = FALSE) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(cluster_colors, pop_colors_vec), 
                    labels = c(names(cluster_colors),pop_colors[,1]),
                    breaks = names(c(cluster_colors, pop_colors_vec))) +
  geom_stratum(alpha = 0.8, width = 1/12, aes(fill = stratum)) +
  # geom_text(stat = "stratum", aes(label = after_stat(stratum))) +
  ggrepel::geom_label_repel(
    aes(label = ifelse(x == "Breeding", as.character(stratum), NA)),
    stat = "stratum", size = 3, direction = "y", nudge_x = .25, fill = "white",
  ) +
  ggrepel::geom_label_repel(
    aes(label = ifelse(x != "Breeding", as.character(stratum), NA)),
    stat = "stratum", size = 3, force = 15, xlim = .75, fill = "white",
  ) +
  scale_x_discrete(limits=rev) +
  coord_flip() +
  theme_void() +
  theme(plot.background = element_rect(fill = "white")) +
  theme(aspect.ratio = 1)

g.alluvial
```

```{r}
g.alluvial_no_weight <- ggplot(amke_lodes,
       aes(x = x, y = Connectivity, stratum = stratum, fill = color, label = stratum,
           alluvium = Con)) +
  geom_alluvium(width = 1/12, show.legend = FALSE) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(cluster_colors, pop_colors_vec), 
                    labels = c(names(cluster_colors),pop_colors[,1]),
                    breaks = names(c(cluster_colors, pop_colors_vec)), name = "Region") +
  geom_stratum(alpha = 0.8, width = 1/12, aes(fill = stratum)) +
  # geom_text(stat = "stratum", aes(label = after_stat(stratum))) +
  ggrepel::geom_label_repel(
    aes(label = ifelse(x == "Breeding", as.character(stratum), NA)),
    stat = "stratum", size = 3, direction = "y", nudge_x = .25, fill = "white",
  ) +
  ggrepel::geom_label_repel(
    aes(label = ifelse(x != "Breeding", as.character(stratum), NA)),
    stat = "stratum", size = 3, force = 20, xlim = .75, fill = "white",
  ) +
  scale_x_discrete(limits=rev) +
  coord_flip() +
  theme_void() +
  theme(plot.background = element_rect(fill = "white")) +
  theme(aspect.ratio = 1)

g.alluvial_no_weight
```

#Plot NMC values
```{r}
library(tidyverse)
# Node names
nodes <- c("AK", "West", "East")

# Node-specific means and SEs
means <- c(0.7686, 0.4295, 0.5983 )
SE <- c(0.13860, 0.02053, 0.01584 )

# Node-specific means and SEs, redoCH
means <- c(0.7705, 0.4301, 0.5983 )
SE <- c(0.14717, 0.02038, 0.01563 )

# Combine into a tibble
nmc_df <- tibble(
  Node = nodes,
  Mean = means,
  SE = SE, 
  Type= "Combined"
)

band_df <- tibble(
  Node = c("West", "East"),
Mean = c(.5019, .6048 ), 
SE = c(.03437, .01833 ),
  Type = "Banding"
)

gen_df <- tibble(
  Node = c("AK", "West", "East"),
  Mean = c( 0.7322, 0.2334, 0.2707),
  SE = c(0.14716, 0.02052, 0.03388 ),
  Type = "Genetic"
)

combined_df <- bind_rows(nmc_df, band_df, gen_df)
combined_df$Type <- factor(combined_df$Type, 
                           levels = c("Banding", "Genetic", "Combined"))
combined_df$Node <- factor(combined_df$Node, levels = c("AK", "West", "East"))

# Define the colors (same as your map)
node_colors <- c(
  AK = "cyan",
  West = "yellow",
  East = "#377eb8"
)
#nmc_df$Node <- factor(nmc_df$Node, levels = c("AK", "West", "East"))

# Plot
combined_plot <- ggplot(combined_df, aes(x = Node, y = Mean, color = Node)) +
  geom_point(size = 4) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = Mean - SE, ymax = Mean + SE), width = 0.2) +
  scale_color_manual(values = node_colors) +
  ylim(0, 1.1) +
  facet_wrap(~Type) +
  labs(
    title = "Node-specific Migratory Connectivity (NMC_XY)",
    x = "Breeding Node",
    y = "NMC (mean ± SE)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5)
  )

combined_plot

ggsave("4.Combined MigCon/FULLcombined_NMC_Oct052026.pdf", combined_plot, width = 10, height = 8)
```

#Creating and saving table of NMCs
```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(gt)

# Input your values here
table_df <- tibble(
  Node = c("AK", "West", "East",
           "AK", "West", "East",
           "AK", "West", "East"),
  
  Type = c("Banding", "Banding", "Banding",
           "Genetic", "Genetic", "Genetic",
           "Combined", "Combined", "Combined"),
  
  Mean = c(NA, .5019, .6048,     # Banding
        0.7322, 0.2334, 0.2707,  # Genetic
         0.7686, 0.4295, 0.5983), # Combined
  
  Lower = c(NA, .4321, .5669,   # <-- replace with your CI lower bounds
            4725, 0.1965 ,0.2059,
            .5401, .3842, .5681),
  
  Upper = c(NA, .5680, .6381,   # <-- replace with your CI upper bounds
            1.0000, 0.2728, 0.3461,
            1.000, .4622, .6291)
)

write_xlsx(table_df,
           "~/Downloads/table_df.xlsx")

# Format Mean (CI)
table_df <- table_df %>%
  mutate(
    Mean_CI = ifelse(
      is.na(Mean),
      "—",
      sprintf("%.3f (%.3f–%.3f)", Mean, Lower, Upper)
    )
  )


# Pivot to wide format
final_table <- table_df %>%
   dplyr::select(Node, Type, Mean_CI) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = Type, values_from = Mean_CI) %>%
  mutate(Node = factor(Node, levels = c("AK", "West", "East"))) %>%
  arrange(Node)

final_table

# Create table
gt_table <- final_table %>%
  gt() %>%
  tab_header(
    title = "Node-specific Migratory Connectivity"
  )

# Save as image
#gtsave(gt_table, "nmc_table.pdf")
```
